text: Click directly on the headline card. In the Fields pane, Power BI highlights which measure is actually populating its Values well, not what the card's title text happens to say.

Don't just stare at the Fields pane and declare victory. Add a second card bound explicitly to the plain Total Sales measure, filter to Southwest again, and watch it change to Southwest's real total, matching the table.

Total Sales All Territories is defined with CALCULATE and ALL of DimTerritory, which strips any filter from that relationship, including the page's own territory slicer. The headline card was bound to that measure instead of the plain one.
With no territory filter applied back in Lesson eleven, both measures returned the same number by coincidence, which is exactly why the mis-binding went unnoticed until now.
This is a binding mistake, not a formula mistake. The measure itself is correct and still needed elsewhere. Next lesson makes the actual fix and validates it properly.
